description: List a page of comments on a Zendesk request, with optional time and author-role filters. The response includes pagination information and may include comment content, attachments and metadata.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing comments on a Zendesk request.

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: traditional uses `?page=2` (integer page number); cursor uses `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). Mutually exclusive.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page. Maximum is 100 records per page for the request comments endpoint.
per_page.title: Per Page

request_id.description: The ID of the request to retrieve comments for.
request_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk request. You can find this ID in the request URL or from a request list.
request_id.title: Request Id

role.description: Filter comments by the role of the author. One of 'agent' or 'end_user'. If not specified, all comments are returned regardless of author role.
role.human_parameter_description: Filter to show only comments by agents or end users. Leave blank to see all comments.
role.title: Role

since.description: Filters comments to include only those from the given datetime and later. Format as ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (e.g., '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z').
since.human_parameter_description: Only show comments created after this datetime. Useful for fetching only new comments since a certain time.
since.title: Since
